notes: Fresh one-step active-identification gate. All unseen clients receive three 0.25 s initial records and exactly one 0.5 s candidate maneuver. Candidate choice uses only predicted Fisher information from the current estimate and nominal closed-loop input templates; evaluation trajectories are never used. Parameter-active minimizes normalized parameter/coordinate covariance trace. Control-active minimizes gain-sensitivity-weighted covariance. Local policies fit three parameters; fleet policies select a learned group and fit a rank-2 head. OracleBestFleet tries all realized candidate records and selects the smallest true scheduled-gain error solely as an unattainable reference.
